name: Greek Tofu Salad with Tomato, Olives, Yogurt Dressing & Breadsticks
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.

Drizzle oil over flatbread, season with spices, and cut into 1½-inch wide strips; transfer to another baking sheet. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and spices; cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the tofu is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the dill.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl along with yogurt, water, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives and add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide salad between plates or bowls and top with tofu. Serve with breadsticks on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
